source_semantics.review: Individually review all ten complete files and26 hunks of the subsequent experimental palette/configuration change. Eight palette declarations become thirteen, including embedded secondary/neutral roles, new tonal values/names and a separate private-error-palette; the two existing hue-estimation/patching helper bodies are byte-identical. Native M3 behavior, compiler floors and real coexistence remain unexecuted obligations.
